views.name: ref_template_types_dim
views.description: Normalized projection of template type reference values. Use when you need a stable lookup of template type codes and descriptions for joins or labeling. | Use for: List all template types and their descriptions; Join template type descriptions onto templates or documents; Filter templates by Template_Type_Code after joining

views.name: templates_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Template_ID,
  Version_Number,
  Template_Type_Code,
  Date_Effective_From,
  Date_Effective_To,
  Template_Details
FROM
  Templates
views.description: One row per template version exposing versioning and effective date columns; use as the canonical template dataset for joins to documents and for temporal filtering (e.g., find templates effective at a time). | Use for: Find templates by effective date range or version; Join templates to template types or documents; Filter current templates where Date_Effective_To IS NULL (or within a range)

views.name: documents_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Document_ID,
  Template_ID,
  Document_Name,
  Document_Description,
  Other_Details
FROM
  Documents
views.description: One row per document exposing document metadata and its linked Template_ID for joins to template details; use when listing or filtering documents and when joining to paragraphs or template info. | Use for: List documents and their template associations; Filter documents by name or description; Join document metadata to paragraphs

views.name: paragraphs_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Paragraph_ID,
  Document_ID,
  Paragraph_Text,
  Other_Details
FROM
  Paragraphs
views.description: One row per paragraph with text and linkage to its Document_ID; use for retrieving paragraph contents or counting paragraphs per document. | Use for: Retrieve paragraphs for a given document; Search paragraph text; Count paragraphs grouped by document

views.name: templates_with_type
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.Template_ID,
  t.Version_Number,
  t.Template_Type_Code,
  r.Template_Type_Description,
  t.Date_Effective_From,
  t.Date_Effective_To,
  t.Template_Details
FROM
  Templates AS t
LEFT JOIN
  Ref_Template_Types AS r
ON
  t.Template_Type_Code = r.Template_Type_Code
views.description: Denormalized view of templates joined to their template type description. Useful when you need template metadata with human-readable type labels for reporting or downstream joins to documents. | Use for: Show templates with type descriptions; Aggregate templates by type description; Filter templates by Template_Type_Description

views.name: documents_with_template_and_type
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.Document_ID,
  d.Template_ID,
  d.Document_Name,
  d.Document_Description,
  d.Other_Details,
  t.Version_Number,
  t.Template_Type_Code,
  r.Template_Type_Description,
  t.Date_Effective_From,
  t.Date_Effective_To,
  t.Template_Details
FROM
  Documents AS d
LEFT JOIN
  Templates AS t
ON
  d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID
LEFT JOIN
  Ref_Template_Types AS r
ON
  t.Template_Type_Code = r.Template_Type_Code
views.description: Documents enriched with their template attributes and template type description. Use for reports that need document metadata together with template version and type context. | Use for: List documents with their template version and type; Filter documents by template attributes or type; Prepare document-level inputs for analytics or exports

views.name: paragraphs_with_document_template_type
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.Paragraph_ID,
  p.Document_ID,
  p.Paragraph_Text,
  p.Other_Details,
  d.Document_Name,
  d.Template_ID,
  t.Version_Number,
  t.Template_Type_Code,
  r.Template_Type_Description
FROM
  Paragraphs AS p
LEFT JOIN
  Documents AS d
ON
  p.Document_ID = d.Document_ID
LEFT JOIN
  Templates AS t
ON
  d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID
LEFT JOIN
  Ref_Template_Types AS r
ON
  t.Template_Type_Code = r.Template_Type_Code
views.description: Paragraphs linked up through their document to the document's template and template type description. Use when analyzing paragraph counts or content in the context of document/template metadata. | Use for: Search paragraph text with document and template context; Count paragraphs by template type or document; Export paragraph-level content with metadata

views.name: documents_paragraph_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.Document_ID,
  d.Template_ID,
  d.Document_Name,
  d.Document_Description,
  COUNT(p.Paragraph_ID) AS Paragraph_Count
FROM
  Documents AS d
LEFT JOIN
  Paragraphs AS p
ON
  d.Document_ID = p.Document_ID
GROUP BY
  d.Document_ID,
  d.Template_ID,
  d.Document_Name,
  d.Document_Description
views.description: Count of paragraphs per document with document metadata preserved. One row per Document_ID with paragraph count. Use for reporting document lengths or filtering documents by paragraph counts. | Use for: Which documents have the most/least paragraphs (combine with a rank downstream)?; Filter documents with zero paragraphs; Aggregate average paragraph count by template

views.name: templates_document_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.Template_ID,
  t.Version_Number,
  t.Template_Type_Code,
  t.Date_Effective_From,
  t.Date_Effective_To,
  t.Template_Details,
  COUNT(d.Document_ID) AS Document_Count
FROM
  Templates AS t
LEFT JOIN
  Documents AS d
ON
  t.Template_ID = d.Template_ID
GROUP BY
  t.Template_ID,
  t.Version_Number,
  t.Template_Type_Code,
  t.Date_Effective_From,
  t.Date_Effective_To,
  t.Template_Details
views.description: Count of documents per template (one row per Template_ID) including template attributes. Use for template usage analysis and to identify templates with no documents. | Use for: Which templates are most used by documents?; Find templates with zero documents; Aggregate documents by template type after joining

views.name: template_current_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Template_ID,
  Version_Number,
  Template_Type_Code,
  Date_Effective_From,
  Date_Effective_To,
  Template_Details,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Template_Type_Code ORDER BY Date_Effective_From DESC NULLS LAST, Version_Number DESC NULLS LAST) AS Type_Version_Rank
FROM
  Templates
views.description: Determines current (active) template versions by Date_Effective_From/Date_Effective_To using a rank per Template_Type_Code or per Template_ID. Exposes a rank so callers can select the top-ranked row(s) as 'current'. Use when you need to pick latest/active template rows without embedding a literal date. | Use for: Select the latest template version per template type (WHERE Type_Version_Rank = 1); Compare current vs prior template versions; Identify templates ordered by effective date within each type

views.name: paragraphs_text_search_prep
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Paragraph_ID,
  Document_ID,
  Paragraph_Text,
  Other_Details,
  LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(Paragraph_Text, ''))) AS Paragraph_Text_search_key
FROM
  Paragraphs
views.description: Normalized paragraph rows prepared for text search: exposes Paragraph_Text and a trimmed lowercase version for deterministic comparisons. Use when implementing case-insensitive searches or deduplication of paragraph text. | Use for: Case-insensitive paragraph search; Detect duplicate paragraph texts across documents; Prepare paragraph text for fuzzy matching downstream
